Corpus français de presse historique PressMint-FR [PressMint]

bibl.title: BnF/Gallica OCR data for Le Temps
Donnees OCR BnF/Gallica pour Le Temps

projectDesc.p: PressMint-FR is a French historical newspaper corpus produced from BnF METS/ALTO OCR data.

editorialDecl.p: OCR text is preserved without correction, except for whitespace normalisation and line-end hyphen handling.

Line-end hyphenation is resolved using ALTO SUBS_TYPE and SUBS_CONTENT attributes where available. Where not available, the hyphen is preserved; when it falls inside a word (the next line starts in lowercase) it is encoded as <pc force="weak">-</pc> and the next <lb/> gets break="no".

ALTO TextBlocks are encoded as TEI paragraphs. A block that ends with a line-end hyphen and is followed by a block starting in lowercase is joined to it in one paragraph. No article or section divisions are inferred, because the source contains no logical structMap.
Page order is derived from the METS physical structMap ORDER attribute. ALTO PHYSICAL_IMG_NR is not used (it is 1 on all pages in this dataset).
Text in an issue is encoded in ALTO reading order. No column-aware geometric reordering is applied.Image references use Gallica IIIF URLs because the master TIFF images are not included.

revisionDesc.change: Second conversion from BnF METS/ALTO to PressMint TEI.
